component.name: 1loop
component.summary: Coding agent for your project, with your model

description.p: 1loop runs an AI agent on your project with the model you choose. It reads and edits files, runs commands in a terminal, drives a browser and, on desktops whose portal allows it, the desktop itself.
This Flatpak runs the agent's commands, its terminal, Git, the browser and Computer Use on the host system through flatpak-spawn: it needs full access to your files and to the host.
